text:
liam (oncall): heads up - alert: sustained p99 latency and elevated 5xxs on TP-sharded kv pipeline in eu-west-1. Incident-bot triggered at 09:02 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2119991111 created: kv-cache paging surge + TP shard imbalance. Severity: high. Notifying oncall and SRE.
liam (oncall): initial graphs show per-rank local_kv_bytes diverging fast on pool-sierra-eu-west around 08:44 UTC. Paging metrics spike shortly after.
dina (sre): seeing heavy NCCL retransmits and occasional allgather stalls. Some ranks stuck in busy-wait while others evict. Kernel logs show repeated EBUSY in the comm thread.
sophia (runtime): we deployed a batching heuristic change last night to favor micro-batches for low-latency. That adjusted ordering of keys across batches. Might be interaction with our TP sharding hash.
raj (eng-ml): adding model context: this workload has many short-prefix queries which cause lots of small KV inserts. If the hashing or routing concentrates prefixes, some shards get churned.
liam (oncall): customer impact: two Dedicated tenants reported ~20% elevated tail latency and a handful of 504s. Support please prepare comms.
jules (support): Ill notify account teams. Drafting a brief: "Were investigating increased latency for certain multi-GPU models in eu-west; teams are mitigating now." Will include MTR estimate.
sophia (runtime): logs excerpt:
```
WARN kv_shard: local_kv_bytes=21.7GB target_local=7.5GB rank=3
ERR eks: pageouts/sec=842 io_wait_ms=410
E NCCL: Request timed out after 90s, rank=3
```
dina (sre): correlation: NCCL timeouts line up with sustained io_wait and eviction thrash: kernel IO queues saturated.
liam (oncall): mitigation idea: temporarily disable micro-batching for TP models and enforce per-shard soft cap. Can we roll config quickly?
sophia (runtime): yes. Will push two changes: set batching.microbatch_enabled=false for TP pools, and set kv.shard.soft_limit_bytes=8589934592 for pool-sierra-eu-west.
deploy-bot: Applying change: batching.microbatch_enabled=false to pool-sierra-eu-west. Rolling out.
canary-bot: Canary started: 5% of traffic to pool-sierra-eu-west using the new kv soft cap and batching off.
sophia (runtime): command used:
```
runtimectl update --pool=pool-sierra-eu-west --set batching.microbatch_enabled=false
runtimectl update --pool=pool-sierra-eu-west --set kv.shard.soft_limit_bytes=8589934592
```
liam (oncall): monitoring p99, paging IO, per-rank kv bytes.
raj (eng-ml): meanwhile adding test case to reproduce skew: generate many short unique prefixes and simulate new batching order.
jules (support): update sent to affected customers at 09:20 UTC: "Mitigation in progress, no data loss, performance impact limited to a subset of requests. We'll follow up with postmortem." :email:
dina (sre): early signals: canary ranks showing local_kv_bytes converging, io_wait decreasing. NCCL retransmits rate down 75% on canary.
sophia (runtime): promoting canary to 30% to confirm. If stable, we will promote full pool.
deploy-bot: Canary promotion: 30% traffic. Monitoring.
liam (oncall): good. If p99 stays <500ms and 5xxs flatten, we'll declare mitigated.
raj (eng-ml): root cause hypothesis: micro-batching reorder + prefix hashing produced a non-uniform key distribution; continuous batching amplified rare hot keys because small batches targeted same shard repeatedly, preventing its eviction policy from keeping up.
sophia (runtime): also applying a short-term change to eviction policy to be more aggressive on ranks crossing soft_limit: set kv.shard.eviction_policy=aggressive.
deploy-bot: Setting kv.shard.eviction_policy=aggressive on pool-sierra-eu-west.
liam (oncall): metrics now: per-rank skew reduced to within 1.3x, paging rate down 60%, p99 from 2.1s -> 420ms.
jules (support): updated customers at 09:47 UTC: "Performance improving; mitigations applied; full stabilization expected in ~30m. We will send a detailed write-up after engineering completes analysis." :thumbsup:
dina (sre): post-incident actions proposed: (1) alert rule for per-rank KV bytes skew ratio >1.5x; (2) block micro-batching toggles for TP pools until we have shard-skew test; (3) add per-shard soft cap by default.
raj (eng-ml): long-term: move to shard-aware routing or salted hashing that accounts for batch ordering. Also add synthetic CI that runs short-prefix storm and measures distribution.
sophia (runtime): filed ticket RUNTIME-4222 "TP KV shard skew - hardening and CI". Assigning to runtime+eng-ml. Also will add telemetry for batch-order -> shard-impact mapping.
liam (oncall): handoff to sophia in 25m for overnight watch. Handoff notes: commands used, current canary state (30% -> promoting if stable), per-rank watchlist added.
liam (oncall): Handoff snippet:
```
runtimectl status --pool=pool-sierra-eu-west --watch
runtimectl update --pool=pool-sierra-eu-west --set kv.shard.soft_limit_bytes=8589934592
```
sophia (runtime): ack. Ill monitor logs, collect NCCL traces if we see >1 timeout, and coordinate postmortem.
jules (support): will close customer notifications once engineering posts final report; customers thanked for patience.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2119991111 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity lowered to medium at 10:05 UTC.
liam (oncall): nice work team. Follow-ups: timeline + action items in INC-2119991111 ticket and postmortem doc. Closing slack thread after handoff. :heart:
